name: Dataset006_TEM12_multires_v2
description: TEM1 (100%) + TEM2 (all annotated subjects) multi-resolution training dataset (v2, nnUNet 2.8.1 retrain). TEM1 native 0.00236 μm/px, TEM2 native 0.00493 μm/px. Each image duplicated at extra resolutions [0.007, 0.01, 0.016] μm/px. No held-out test split — both datasets used fully for training, fold_all.
